native_contract.completion_mask_definition: int(label != -100) from verified native CompletionMask; validate equal shape, 0/1 mask and exact recorded counts for every selected response before backward.
native_contract.collator: Pinned standard TRL DataCollatorForLanguageModeling; right pad input=pad token, attention=0 and labels=-100; mask completion_mask==0. skip_prepare_dataset bypasses max_length enforcement, so entry rejects lengths itself.
native_contract.loss_normalization: Native Qwen3 ForCausalLMLoss sum CE / valid tokens within each standard accumulation window, including tail3; not equal weighting of per-candidate mean NLL.

trainable_policy.only: Single default adapter LoRA A/B on q_proj/v_proj in all28 native attention layers; no embeddings/lm_head/bias/base trainable.

trainable_policy.optimizer_membership: Exact identity set of trainable adapter parameters, no duplicates or base parameters.
trainable_policy.initial_snapshot: Private clones of actual named trainable tensors after standard construction and before backward.
trainable_policy.gradient_none_policy: At every on_pre_optimizer_step after actual backward/clip and before optimizer call, every trainable adapter parameter must have a gradient and every gradient element finite. None/nonfinite/unobservable fails before that step; no values exported.

native_contract.standard_order: seed42/data_seed42 and pinned standard Trainer/Accelerate sampler, shuffle as standard; dataset order does not prove actual consumption. Callback has no raw batch IDs.
native_contract.observer_truth: on_pre_optimizer_step follows backward/clip; on_optimizer_step means step call returned and sees old global_step; on_step_end increments global_step even if optimizer skip. Observe public step_was_skipped if available else null/UNKNOWN. No callback-only success/update/row-ID inference.
native_contract.save_truth: Normal train return and observed7 opportunities are distinct from non-skipped return and numerical parameter change. Then call Trainer.save_model once; explicit save_model does not emit on_save. on_train_end is not durable save/whole-plan proof. Numerical no-change is a valid measured negative result.
